integrity: The theorem is derived directly from neighborhood sums in a complete multipartite graph. A separate exhaustive checker evaluates the original definition on every ternary labeling through order nine, compares all coefficients with the closed enumerator, and checks the published minimum-value specialization.
scientific_limitations: The all-function classification and enumerator are restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs.
The minimum perfect Italian domination number for complete multipartite graphs with every part of size at least three is prior published work.
A later cograph algorithm already gives broader algorithmic coverage of the minimum-value problem.
Finite exhaustive verification through order nine is corroborative only.
Full text of the cograph paper was not available from the inspected lawful-access routes, leaving a limited access-related originality risk.
title: Perfect Italian domination weight enumerator of complete multipartite graphs
